changelog:
**Expanded to support post titles in addition to opening hooks.**

- Now generates both opening hooks and post titles/headlines for long-form articles.
- Triggers when user requests a title, titre d'article, or headline, alongside hook and opening requests.
- Adds behavior for confirming post title brief and handling titling steps.
- Reference title formulas included as an external file.
- Internal technical updates: updated tool usage (now uses AskUserQuestion); compatibility note revised. 
- Removed unused file (`skill-card.md`) to clean up skill files.
summary: Generate opening hooks and post titles for long-form articles in EN or FR — blog posts, Substack/Medium/dev.to, LinkedIn long-form, paid newsletters, opinion essays, reported features, technical deep-dives. Trigger whenever the user asks for a hook, opening, lede, intro, first sentence/paragraph, opener, accroche, attaque, phrase d'accroche, or première phrase — including making a flat intro punchier or rewriting a draft opening. Also trigger when user asks for a post title, titre d'article, headline, or when ghostwriting skills reach the opening or titling step. Proposes 3-4 hooks pulling distinct psychological levers (curiosity gap, contrarian, scene, promise, authority), 2 candidates each, waits for the user to pick. Do NOT trigger for social posts (LinkedIn feed, Twitter/X, TikTok, Bluesky, Threads), READMEs or doc first lines, taglines, email subjects or openers, ad copy (Google/Meta Ads), landing-page headlines, press releases, SEO meta, fiction openings, talk/podcast/video script intros, or body rewrites.
